selected_bottleneck: repository-summary-canonical-file-identity（仓库摘要规范文件身份完整性）
selected_problem: After bounded context selection and exact-path indexing learned canonical lexical file identity, repositorySummary still counted lexical aliases as separate files and extensions. A manifest containing src/a.js plus equivalent spellings could report fileCount=4 while contextRecovery.indexedPaths=2, so the same code reality had contradictory summary counts.
decision_basis: This is a fresh-main summary-integrity defect directly falsifiable after the previous path-identity merge.
The change reuses canonical lexical path identity and derives extension/top-level metadata from canonical paths; it does not select a new context or synthesis architecture.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502, so this cycle uses DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY（DWAC 源码契约重放） and does not claim a hosted DWAC success receipt.
change: repositorySummary now canonicalizes and deduplicates visible lexical file paths before fileCount, extension histogram, top-level hints and totalManifestPaths are computed. Extensions are derived from canonical paths rather than potentially conflicting duplicate manifest metadata.

validation.focused_tests: 5/5 PASS, 0 skipped: new summary path-identity regression plus determinism, credential-metadata exclusion, extension truncation and top-level truncation regressions

truth_boundary: This closes lexical alias overcounting in repository summary metadata. It does not claim filesystem case/Unicode equivalence, conflicting physical-file provenance arbitration, exhaustive repository coverage, parser-grade module semantics, or arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
